rationale: Rear-end motor vehicle collision with vehicle totaled and policyholder sustained bodily injuries; clear-cut auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was struck from behind on Route 9 while stopped at a red light, resulting in a totaled vehicle with severe trunk damage and policyholder sustaining whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver information is documented on the police report; this will proceed as a liability recovery case against the at-fault party's carrier.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision at red light; other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
